description:
Measurement data supporting the manuscript Path Recovery Based on End-to-End Quality Prediction and Link-Level Fault Identification in Multi-Hop Networks.

The experiments use a 14-node Raspberry Pi mesh running babeld, with link degradation applied using Linux netem. The dataset contains 385 cycles: 150 collection cycles for model training and evaluation, and 235 cycles covering protocol-only, threshold-based, time-series-only, proposed, fixed path-wide recovery, and loss-only experiments.

The dataset includes end-to-end and per-link measurements, link labels, cycle-level recovery metrics, module outputs, and post-recovery paths. Column definitions, cycle exclusions, and data splits are documented in README.md.
